why: ISK-equivalent value of PROGRESS, so next can compare an agent mission, a haul, a trade, or an experiment in one currency (ISK per hour). Edit the numbers if you disagree. 'priors' are guessed ISK/hr for activities you have never timed (replaced by your real runs after 3).
career_point_note: ISK-equivalent of ONE AIR career point: 66.7 SP per point x ~1,667 ISK per SP (injector price) = ~111,000; the account is OMEGA (skill points can be extracted/injected), so 50% of that is used: 55,000. Edit if you disagree.
